title: Self-taught, and Joe Thomas getting him started at Casa Manana
summary: He never played in a school band and taught himself to read; Joe Thomas of Lunceford's band, whom he met in Seattle, helped him on arrival in California.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: No, I couldn't hardly read at all. I had to teach myself to read later. By the time I taught myself to read, I was almost (?).
Did you play in the school band?
So it was strictly on your own, then.

That's it. All alone. When I came to California, Lunceford was playing at Casa Manana. So the first thing I did was drop my luggage and head for the Casa Manana. Then I went backstage and I said, 'I want to speak to Joe Thomas. He's a friend of mine.' Joe got me in and got me started.
Yeah. He and Snooky and Gerald Wilson and Trummy.
